packs.name: Anthropic · Personal blogs
packs.title: Anthropic · Personal blogs
packs.description: Writing from the people building Claude, on their own sites: product engineering, interpretability, alignment, security and philosophy. Eleven verified authors; eight with working feeds. This v1.1.0 refresh adds Andrej Karpathy (joined Anthropic in May 2026) and re-checks every v1.0.0 feed. Schema-v1 successor to the v0.1.0 site pack of the same id.

attention_estimate.basis: Sum of enabled sources' cadence estimates on 2026-11-17. One weekly newsletter (Import AI) is ~4.3 of the 6.1; Karpathy adds ~0.6; the other six enabled sources together add roughly one post a month. Two enabled sources (Olah, Askell) are dormant archives that currently add nothing, and two more (Olah again, Carlsmith) have feeds focu cannot currently consume — see their readiness notes.

packs.name: Geothermal Industry
packs.title: Geothermal Industry
packs.description: The geothermal industry's own paper trail: the trade-press wire, association policy and market news, and project and company announcements from EGS, closed-loop and conventional developers — every source fetched live and dated on 2026-11-17.

attention_estimate.basis: Sum of enabled sources' cadence estimates on 2026-11-17: 92.4 posts/month, of which ≈78 is ThinkGeoEnergy's full news wire (≈2.6 items/day; its max_items_per_day of 5 and the briefing's selection budget bound what actually surfaces). The other six enabled sources together add ≈14/month. Five further verified publications are listed disabled (no working feed) and add nothing until an HTML adapter lands.

attention_estimate.basis: Sum of enabled sources' cadence estimates on 2026-11-17: ≈127 posts/month. Two bursty wires dominate — LangChain ≈31.5 and Socket ≈19 (a security-news burst rate) — and both carry max_items_per_day 2; the other eleven enabled sources together add ≈77/month.
